question: Who was the Solicitor General of India as of January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tushar Mehta.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• As of January 2021, **Tushar Mehta** is the Solicitor General of India.
 
• He was appointed as Solicitor General of India in 2018.
 
• .He was appointed as **Additional **Solicitor General of India** in 2014**
 
• The post had been lying vacant since October 2017 when the then Solicitor General Ranjit Kumar had resigned.
 
• Solicitor General is the second-highest-ranking law officer of the government after the Attorney General.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice J K Maheshwari** is a Judge of the Supreme Court of India who served as the Chief Justice of Sikkim and Andhra Pradesh High Courts.
 
• As of November 2021, **KK Venugopal **is the Attorney General of India.
 
• **Hima Kohli **is the first woman Chief Justice of Telangana High Court since it was separated from the Andhra Pradesh High Court in 2019.
